products.name: Nature's Heritage - Tropical & Citrus x Early Lemon Berry - .5G 2pk Pre-roll - Sample
products.description: Nature's Heritage brings you Tropical & Citrus x Early Lemon Berry pre-rolls, a convenient 2-pack totaling 1g of premium flower. This exciting cross delivers a vibrant fusion of tropical fruit notes with bright citrus and zesty lemon berry undertones that awaken the senses. Each .5g pre-roll is expertly crafted for smooth, flavorful sessions whether you're at home or on the go. The exotic flavor profile features layers of sweet tropical fruits complemented by tangy citrus and refreshing lemon, creating a uniquely satisfying smoke. Perfect for cannabis enthusiasts seeking quality and convenience in one package, these pre-rolls showcase Nature's Heritage's commitment to premium flower and exceptional taste. Ideal for sharing or enjoying solo, this sample pack lets you experience bold, citrus-forward flavor with the trusted quality Nature's Heritage is known for.

products.name: Nature's Heritage - Grape Diamonds - .5G Live Sauce - Dispo
products.description: Nature's Heritage Grape Diamonds .5g Live Sauce All-In-One cartridge delivers a premium vaping experience with bold, fruity flavor in a convenient, ready-to-use format. This disposable device features live sauce extract, preserving the plant's natural terpene profile for an authentic, strain-specific taste. Expect rich grape and sweet berry notes with hints of earthy undertones that create a smooth, flavorful draw from first puff to last. The live sauce consistency ensures robust flavor and potent effects in every session. Ideal for on-the-go enjoyment, this .5g all-in-one requires no charging or separate battery—simply inhale and savor the concentrated cannabis experience. Nature's Heritage brings quality craftsmanship to this portable cartridge, making it perfect for both seasoned enthusiasts and newcomers seeking hassle-free convenience without compromising on taste or potency.
